sentences.zh: 婁室，字斡里衍，完顏部人。

translations.literal: Lou Shi, style name Woliyan, was a man of the Wanyan tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi, styled Woliyan, was of the Wanyan clan.

sentences.zh: 年二十一，代父白荅為七水諸部長。

translations.literal: At age twenty-one he succeeded his father Baida as chief of the Seven Waters tribes.
translations.idiomatic: At twenty-one he succeeded his father Baida as head of the Seven Waters tribes.

sentences.zh: 太祖克甯江州，使婁室招輸系遼籍女直，遂降移燉益海路太彎照撒等。

translations.literal: When the Taizu took Ningjiang Prefecture, he sent Lou Shi to win over Jurchen registered under the Liao in the Shuxi line, and thereby brought over Yidian of the Yihai Route, Taiwan Zhaosa, and others.
translations.idiomatic: After the Taizu captured Ningjiang, he sent Lou Shi to win over Jurchen enrolled in Liao registers along the Shuxi line, and Yidian of the Yihai Route, Taiwan Zhaosa, and others submitted.

sentences.zh: 敗遼兵於婆刺趕山。

translations.literal: He defeated Liao troops at Poligan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Liao forces at Poligan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 複敗遼兵，擒兩將軍。

translations.literal: Again he defeated Liao troops and captured two generals.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated the Liao again and took two generals prisoner.

sentences.zh: 既而益改、捺末懶兩路皆降。

translations.literal: Thereafter the Yigai and Namolian routes both submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward both the Yigai and Namolian routes surrendered.

sentences.zh: 進兵鹹州，克之。

translations.literal: He advanced against Xian Prefecture and took it.
translations.idiomatic: He marched on Xian Prefecture and captured it.

sentences.zh: 諸部相繼來降，獲遼北女直系籍之戶。

translations.literal: Tribes submitted one after another, and households of Northern Jurchen registered under the Liao were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Tribes submitted in succession, and he secured households of Northern Jurchen on Liao registers.

sentences.zh: 遼都統耶律訛里朵以二十餘萬眾來戍邊。

translations.literal: The Liao commander-in-chief Yelü Eliduo came with more than two hundred thousand men to garrison the border.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao commander-in-chief Yelü Eliduo marched to the frontier with over two hundred thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 太祖趨達魯古城，次甯江州西，召婁室。

translations.literal: The Taizu hurried to Dalucheng, halted west of Ningjiang Prefecture, and summoned Lou Shi.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu pressed on to Dalucheng and camped west of Ningjiang, then summoned Lou Shi.

sentences.zh: 婁室見上於軍中。

translations.literal: Lou Shi saw the sovereign in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi presented himself to the sovereign in camp.

sentences.zh: 上見婁室馬多疲乏，以三百給之，使隸右翼宗翰軍，與銀朮可縱兵沖其中堅，凡九陷陣，皆力戰而出。

translations.literal: The sovereign saw that Lou Shi's horses were mostly worn out and gave him three hundred; he had him attached to the right wing under Zonghan, and with Yinzhuke he drove troops against the enemy center; nine times he entered the battle line and each time fought his way out.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing Lou Shi's horses mostly spent, the sovereign gave him three hundred fresh mounts and placed him under Zonghan's right wing; with Yinzhuke he charged the enemy center, broke into the line nine times, and each time fought his way clear.

sentences.zh: 複與銀朮可戍邊。

translations.literal: Again he garrisoned the border with Yinzhuke.
translations.idiomatic: He again garrisoned the frontier with Yinzhuke.

sentences.zh: 及九百奚營等部來降，則與銀朮可攻黃龍府，上使完顏渾黜、婆盧火、石古乃以兵四千助之，敗遼兵萬余于白馬濼。

translations.literal: When the Jiubai Xi camp and other groups submitted, he then with Yinzhuke attacked Huanglong Prefecture; the sovereign sent Wanyan Hunchu, Poluhuo, and Shigunai with four thousand troops to assist, and they defeated more than ten thousand Liao troops at Baima Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jiubai Xi camp and other groups submitted, he and Yinzhuke attacked Huanglong; the sovereign sent Wanyan Hunchu, Poluhuo, and Shigunai with four thousand men to help, and they routed over ten thousand Liao troops at Baima Marsh.

sentences.zh: 宗雄等下金山縣，使婁室分兵二千，招沿山逃散之人。

translations.literal: Zongxiong and others took Jinshan County; Lou Shi was sent with two thousand troops to win over people scattered along the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Zongxiong and others captured Jinshan County, and Lou Shi was detached with two thousand men to gather people fleeing in the hills.

sentences.zh: 耶律捏里軍蒺藜山，斡魯古、婁室等破之，遂取顯州。

translations.literal: Yelü Nieli encamped at Jili Mountain; Wolugu, Lou Shi, and others defeated him and then took Xian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Nieli held Jili Mountain; Wolugu, Lou Shi, and others broke his force and took Xian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 太祖取黃龍府，婁室請曰：「黃龍一都會，且僻遠，苟有變，則鄰郡相扇而起。

translations.literal: When the Taizu took Huanglong Prefecture, Lou Shi requested, saying, "Huanglong is a great metropolis, and moreover remote; if trouble arises, neighboring prefectures will stir one another up.
translations.idiomatic: After the Taizu took Huanglong, Lou Shi urged, "Huanglong is a major capital and far away; if anything goes wrong, neighboring districts will rise together.

sentences.zh: 請以所部屯守。」

translations.literal: He asked to garrison it with his own command."
translations.idiomatic: Let me hold it with my own troops."

sentences.zh: 太祖然之，仍合諸路謀克，命婁室為萬戶，守黃龍府。

translations.literal: The Taizu approved, still combined the meng'an of the various routes, appointed Lou Shi as a commander of ten thousand households, and had him guard Huanglong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu agreed, combined the meng'an of the various routes, made Lou Shi commander of ten thousand households, and left him to guard Huanglong.

sentences.zh: 進都統，從杲取中京，與希尹等襲走迪六、和尚、雅里斯等，敗奚王霞末，降奚部西陳度訛里刺。

translations.literal: He was promoted to commander-in-chief, followed Gao in taking the Central Capital, and with Xiyin and others routed Diliu, Heshang, Yalisi, and others, defeated the Xi king Xiamo, and received the submission of the Xi chieftain Xichendu Elici.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to commander-in-chief, he followed Gao in taking the Central Capital; with Xiyin and others he drove off Diliu, Heshang, and Yalisi, defeated the Xi king Xiamo, and won over the Xi leader Xichendu Elici.

sentences.zh: 遼主自鴛鴦濼西走，婁室等追至白水濼，獲其內庫寶物。

translations.literal: The Liao sovereign fled west from Yuanyang Marsh; Lou Shi and others pursued to Baishui Marsh and seized the treasures of the inner storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao emperor fled west from Yuanyang Marsh; Lou Shi and others pursued to Baishui Marsh and seized the imperial treasury.

sentences.zh: 數字遂與闍母攻破西京。

translations.literal: Lou Shi then together with Samar attacked and took the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi then joined Samar in storming the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 複與闍母至天德、雲內、甯邊、東勝，其官吏皆降，獲阿疏。

translations.literal: Again with Samar he reached Tiande, Yunnei, Ningbian, and Dongsheng; their officials all submitted, and Ashu was captured.
translations.idiomatic: He again advanced with Samar to Tiande, Yunnei, Ningbian, and Dongsheng; the officials all surrendered, and Ashu was taken.

sentences.zh: 夏人救遼，兵次天德，婁室使突撚、補攧以騎二百為候兵，夏人敗之，幾盡。

translations.literal: The Xia came to aid the Liao and halted at Tiande; Lou Shi sent Tuanian and Buzhan with two hundred horsemen as scouts, and the Xia defeated them, nearly wiping them out.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia marched to rescue the Liao and camped at Tiande; Lou Shi sent Tuanian and Buzhan with two hundred horsemen as scouts, and the Xia routed them, nearly annihilating the force.

sentences.zh: 阿士罕複以二百騎往，遇伏兵，獨阿士罕脫歸。

translations.literal: Ashihan again went with two hundred horsemen, met an ambush, and only Ashihan escaped back.
translations.idiomatic: Ashihan led another two hundred horsemen out, ran into an ambush, and only he made it back.

sentences.zh: 時久雨，諸將欲且休息，婁室曰：「彼再破吾騎兵，我若不復往，彼將以我怯，即來攻我矣。」

translations.literal: Rain had lasted long; the generals wished to rest for a time, but Lou Shi said, "They have twice broken our cavalry; if we do not go again, they will take us for timid and at once attack us."
translations.idiomatic: After days of rain the generals wanted to pause, but Lou Shi said, "They have beaten our cavalry twice; if we stay put they will think us afraid and come straight at us."

sentences.zh: 乃選千騎，與習失、拔離速往。

translations.literal: He then chose a thousand horsemen and went with Xishi and Balisu.
translations.idiomatic: He chose a thousand horsemen and went with Xishi and Balisu.

sentences.zh: 斡魯壯其言，從之。

translations.literal: Wolu admired his words and followed him.
translations.idiomatic: Wolu approved his resolve and went along.

sentences.zh: 婁室遲明出陵野嶺，留拔離速以兵二百據險守之。

translations.literal: Lou Shi set out at daybreak from Lingye Ridge and left Balisu with two hundred troops holding the defile.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi marched at dawn from Lingye Ridge and left Balisu with two hundred men on the heights.

sentences.zh: 獲生口問之，其帥李良輔也。

translations.literal: Captives were taken and questioned; their commander was Li Liangfu.
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners identified their commander as Li Liangfu.

sentences.zh: 將至野谷，登高望之。

translations.literal: As they were about to reach Yegu, they climbed high and looked out.
translations.idiomatic: Near Yegu they climbed a height to survey the field.

sentences.zh: 夏人恃眾而不整，方濟水為陣，乃使人報斡魯。

translations.literal: The Xia relied on their numbers and were not in good order; they were just crossing the water to form battle lines, and messengers were sent to report to Wolu.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia trusted their numbers and stood in disorder, still crossing the river to form ranks, and Lou Shi sent word to Wolu.

sentences.zh: 婁室分軍為二，迭出迭入，進退轉戰三十里。

translations.literal: Lou Shi divided the army in two, going out and in by turns, advancing and retreating and fighting for thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi split his force in two and harried the enemy in alternating thrusts and withdrawals for thirty li.

sentences.zh: 過宜水，斡魯軍亦至，合擊敗之。

translations.literal: Crossing Yishui, Wolu's army also arrived, and together they defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: After crossing the Yishui, Wolu's troops came up as well, and together they routed the Xia.

sentences.zh: 遼都統大石犯奉聖州，壁龍門東二十五里，婁室、照里、馬和尚等以兵取之，生獲大石，其眾遂降。

translations.literal: The Liao commander-in-chief Dashi attacked Fengsheng Prefecture and encamped twenty-five li east of Longmen; Lou Shi, Zhaoli, Ma Heshang, and others took him with troops, captured Dashi alive, and his followers then submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao commander Dashi struck Fengsheng and camped twenty-five li east of Longmen; Lou Shi, Zhaoli, Ma Heshang, and others attacked, took Dashi alive, and his army surrendered.

sentences.zh: 遼辟里刺守奉聖州，棄城遁去。

translations.literal: The Liao officer Pilici guarded Fengsheng Prefecture, abandoned the city, and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao defender Pilici held Fengsheng, then abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 後與宗望追遼帝，婁室，蒲宗以二十騎候敵，敗其軍三千人於三山，有千人將趨奉聖州，蒲察複敗之，擒其主帥而還。

translations.literal: Later, pursuing the Liao emperor with Zongwang, Lou Shi and Puzong with twenty horsemen scouted the enemy, defeated three thousand of his troops at Sanshan, and when a thousand were about to head for Fengsheng Prefecture, Pucha again defeated them, captured their commander, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Later, pursuing the Liao emperor with Zongwang, Lou Shi and Puzong scouted with twenty horsemen, routed three thousand men at Sanshan, and when another thousand headed for Fengsheng, Pucha beat them again, seized their commander, and returned.

sentences.zh: 夏人屯兵於可敦館，宗翰遣婁室戍朔州，築城於霸德山西南二十里，遂破朔州西山兵二萬，擒其帥趙公直。

translations.literal: The Xia encamped at Kedun Post; Zonghan sent Lou Shi to garrison Shuozhou and built a city twenty li southwest of Bade Mountain, then defeated twenty thousand Xia troops of the western hills of Shuozhou and captured their commander Zhao Gongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia camped at Kedun; Zonghan sent Lou Shi to hold Shuozhou, built a fort twenty li southwest of Bade Mountain, broke twenty thousand Xia troops on the western hills, and captured their commander Zhao Gongzhi.

sentences.zh: 其後複襲遼帝于余都穀，獲之。

translations.literal: Afterward he again surprised the Liao emperor at Yudu Valley and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: He later ambushed the Liao emperor in Yudu Valley and took him prisoner.

sentences.zh: 賜鐵券，惟死罪乃笞之，餘罪不問。

translations.literal: He was granted an iron certificate: only for capital crimes might he be flogged; other offenses were not prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: He received an iron certificate of mercy: only capital offenses could bring a beating; lesser crimes went unpunished.

sentences.zh: 銀朮可圍太原，宋統制劉臻救太原，率眾十萬出壽陽，婁室擊破之，繼敗宋兵數千於榆次。

translations.literal: Yinzhuke besieged Taiyuan; the Song controller Liu Zhen came to relieve Taiyuan, leading one hundred thousand men out from Shouyang; Lou Shi defeated him and afterward defeated several thousand Song troops at Yuci.
translations.idiomatic: While Yinzhuke besieged Taiyuan, the Song controller Liu Zhen marched from Shouyang with one hundred thousand men to relieve the city; Lou Shi routed him and then cut down several thousand Song troops at Yuci.

sentences.zh: 宋張灝軍出汾州，拔離速擊走之。

translations.literal: The Song army of Zhang Hao came out from Fenzhou; Balisu drove it off.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hao led Song forces out of Fenzhou; Balisu drove them back.

sentences.zh: 灝複營文水，數室也突葛速、拔離速與戰，灝大敗。

translations.literal: Hao again encamped at Wenshui; Lou Shi, Yetugesu, and Balisu fought him, and Hao was badly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Hao re-formed at Wenshui; Lou Shi, Yetugesu, and Balisu engaged him and inflicted a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 宗翰定太原，婁室取汾、石二州，及其屬縣溫泉、方山、離石，蒲察降壽陽，取平定軍及樂平，複招降遼州及榆社、遼山、和順諸縣。

translations.literal: When Zonghan secured Taiyuan, Lou Shi took the two prefectures of Fen and Shi and their subordinate counties Wenquan, Fangshan, and Lishi; Pucha received the submission of Shouyang, took Pingding Army and Leping, and again won over Liaozhou and the counties of Yushe, Liaoshan, and Heshun.
translations.idiomatic: After Zonghan secured Taiyuan, Lou Shi took Fen and Shi prefectures with Wenquan, Fangshan, and Lishi; Pucha reduced Shouyang, seized Pingding Army and Leping, and won over Liaozhou with Yushe, Liaoshan, and Heshun.

sentences.zh: 宗翰趨汴州，使婁室等自平陽道先趨河南，曰：「若至澤州，與賽里、婆盧火、習失遇，當與俱進。」

translations.literal: Zonghan hurried to Bianzhou and sent Lou Shi and others by the Pingyang route to press ahead into Henan first, saying, "If you reach Ze Prefecture and meet Saili, Poluhuo, and Xishi, you should advance together."
translations.idiomatic: Zonghan pressed on to Bianzhou and sent Lou Shi and others down the Pingyang road into Henan ahead of him, saying, "When you reach Ze Prefecture and meet Saili, Poluhuo, and Xishi, advance together."

sentences.zh: 習失之前軍三謀克，敗宋兵三千於襄垣，遇伏兵二千，又敗之。

translations.literal: Xishi's vanguard of three meng'an defeated three thousand Song troops at Xiangyuan, met two thousand ambush troops, and defeated them again.
translations.idiomatic: Xishi's vanguard of three meng'an routed three thousand Song troops at Xiangyuan, then met two thousand men in ambush and beat them as well.

sentences.zh: 撒刺荅破天井關，複破步兵于孔子廟南，遂降河陽。

translations.literal: Salida broke Tianjing Pass, again defeated infantry south of the Confucius Temple, and thereby received the submission of Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: Salida stormed Tianjing Pass, broke Song infantry south of the Confucius Temple, and Heyang surrendered.

sentences.zh: 婁室軍至，既渡河，遂薄西京。

translations.literal: When Lou Shi's army arrived, having already crossed the river, it pressed close to the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi's army arrived, crossed the river, and closed on the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 城中兵來拒戰，習失逆擊敗之，西京降。

translations.literal: Troops in the city came out to resist; Xishi met and defeated them, and the Western Capital submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison troops came out to fight; Xishi met them and drove them back, and the Western Capital surrendered.

sentences.zh: 婁室取偃師，永安軍、鞏縣降。

translations.literal: Lou Shi took Yanshi; Yong'an Army and Gong County submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi took Yanshi, and Yong'an Army and Gong County submitted.

sentences.zh: 撒刺荅敗宋兵于汜水。

translations.literal: Salida defeated Song troops at Sishui.
translations.idiomatic: Salida defeated Song forces at Sishui.

sentences.zh: 於是，滎陽、滎澤、鄭州、中牟相次皆降。

translations.literal: Thereupon Xingyang, Xingze, Zhengzhou, and Zhongmou submitted one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyang, Xingze, Zhengzhou, and Zhongmou then surrendered in succession.

sentences.zh: 宗翰已與宗望會軍於汴，使婁室率師趨陝津，攻河東郡縣之未下者。

translations.literal: Zonghan had already joined Zongwang at Bian and sent Lou Shi to lead troops toward Shan Ford to attack the commanderies and counties of Hedong not yet taken.
translations.idiomatic: Zonghan had already joined Zongwang at Bian and sent Lou Shi toward Shan Ford to reduce the remaining Hedong prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 阿離士罕敗敵於河上，撒按敗敵於陝城下，鶻沙虎降虢州守陴卒三百人，遂克陝府。

translations.literal: Alishihan defeated the enemy on the river; Sa'an defeated the enemy below Shan City; Hushahu received the submission of three hundred wall-guards of Guozhou and thereby took Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Alishihan beat the enemy on the river, Sa'an routed them below Shan City, Hushahu won over three hundred Guozhou wall-guards, and Shan Prefecture fell.

sentences.zh: 習古乃、桑袞破陝之散卒于平陸西北。

translations.literal: Xigunai and Sanggun defeated scattered troops of Shan at the northwest of Pinglu.
translations.idiomatic: Xigunai and Sanggun cut down scattered Shan garrison troops northwest of Pinglu.

sentences.zh: 活女別破敵于平陸。

translations.literal: Huonu separately defeated the enemy at Pinglu.
translations.idiomatic: Huonu separately defeated enemy forces at Pinglu.

sentences.zh: 婁室破蒲、解之軍二萬，盡覆之，安邑、解州皆降，遂克河中府，降絳、慈、隰、石等州。

translations.literal: Lou Shi defeated the armies of Pu and Xie, twenty thousand men, and utterly overthrew them; Anyi and Xie Prefecture both submitted, and he then took Hezhong Prefecture and received the submission of Jiang, Ci, Xi, Shi, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi shattered twenty thousand troops from Pu and Xie, overran them completely, and Anyi and Xie Prefecture surrendered; he then took Hezhong and won Jiang, Ci, Xi, Shi, and the rest.

sentences.zh: 宗翰往洛陽，使婁室取陝西，敗宋將範致虛軍，下同、華二州，克京兆府，獲宋制置使傅亮，遂克鳳翔。

translations.literal: Zonghan went to Luoyang and sent Lou Shi to take Shaanxi; he defeated the army of the Song general Fan Zhixu, took the two prefectures of Tong and Hua, captured the Song prefectural commissioner Fu Liang at Jingzhao Prefecture, and then took Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zonghan went to Luoyang and sent Lou Shi into Shaanxi; he defeated Fan Zhixu's army, took Tong and Hua, seized the Song commissioner Fu Liang at Chang'an, and then captured Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 阿鄰等破宋大兵於河中，斡魯破宋劉光烈軍于馮翊，訛特刺、桑袞敗敵于渭水，遂取下邽。

translations.literal: Alin and others defeated a great Song army at Hezhong; Wolu defeated the Song army of Liu Guanglie at Tongyi; Eteli and Sanggun defeated the enemy at the Wei River and then took Xiaji.
translations.idiomatic: Alin and others broke a large Song force at Hezhong, Wolu routed Liu Guanglie at Tongyi, Eteli and Sanggun beat the enemy on the Wei, and Xiaji fell.

sentences.zh: 宗翰會京輔伐康王，命婁室、蒲察專事陝西，以婆盧火、繩果監戰。

translations.literal: Zonghan assembled forces from the capital region to attack the Prince of Kang and ordered Lou Shi and Pucha to devote themselves to Shaanxi, with Poluhuo and Shengguo overseeing the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Zonghan gathered troops from the capital districts to strike the Prince of Kang and put Lou Shi and Pucha in charge of Shaanxi, with Poluhuo and Shengguo supervising operations.

sentences.zh: 繩果等遇敵于蒲城及同州，皆破之。

translations.literal: Shengguo and others met the enemy at Pucheng and Tong Prefecture and defeated them in each case.
translations.idiomatic: Shengguo and others met the enemy at Pucheng and Tongzhou and defeated them both.

sentences.zh: 婁室、蒲察克丹州，破臨真，進克延安府，遂降綏德軍及靜邊、懷遠等城寨十六，複破青澗城。

translations.literal: Lou Shi and Pucha took Dan Prefecture, broke Linzhen, advanced and took Yan'an Prefecture, then received the submission of Suide Army and sixteen fortresses including Jingbian and Huaiyuan, and again took Qingjian Fortress.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi and Pucha captured Danzhou, broke Linzhen, stormed Yan'an, and won Suide Army plus sixteen forts including Jingbian and Huaiyuan; they also took Qingjian.

sentences.zh: 宋安撫使折可求以麟、府、豐三州，及堡寨九，降于婁室。

translations.literal: The Song pacification commissioner Zhe Keqiu submitted to Lou Shi the three prefectures of Lin, Fu, and Feng and nine fortresses.
translations.idiomatic: The Song pacification commissioner Zhe Keqiu surrendered Lin, Fu, and Feng prefectures and nine forts to Lou Shi.

sentences.zh: 晉寧所部九寨皆降，而晉寧軍久不下，婁室欲去之，賽里不可，曰：「此與夏鄰，且生他變。」

translations.literal: The nine fortresses under Jining all submitted, but Jining Army long would not fall; Lou Shi wished to leave it, but Saili would not allow it, saying, "This borders the Xia and would breed other troubles."
translations.idiomatic: Nine forts under Jining surrendered, but Jining itself held out; Lou Shi wanted to move on, but Saili objected: "It borders the Xia and trouble will spread if we leave it."

sentences.zh: 城中無井，日取河水以為飲，乃決渠於東，泄其水，城中遂困。

translations.literal: There were no wells in the city; each day they drew river water to drink; he then cut a canal on the east and drained the water, and the city was thereby distressed.
translations.idiomatic: The city had no wells and drew river water daily, so he cut a canal on the east and drained it, and the garrison was brought to straits.

sentences.zh: 李位、石乙啟郭門降，諸將率兵入城。

translations.literal: Li Wei and Shi Yi opened the outer gate and submitted; the generals led troops into the city.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wei and Shi Yi opened the gate and surrendered, and the generals led their men in.

sentences.zh: 守將徐徽言據子城，戰三日，眾潰，徽言出奔，獲之。

translations.literal: The defending general Xu Huiyan held the inner citadel and fought three days; the troops collapsed, Huiyan fled out and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Defender Xu Huiyan held the inner citadel for three days until his force broke; he fled and was taken.

sentences.zh: 使之拜，不聽，臨之以兵，不為動，縶之軍中。

translations.literal: They made him bow; he would not listen; they confronted him with troops; he was unmoved and was bound in the army.
translations.idiomatic: They ordered him to bow; he refused. They threatened him with arms; he did not flinch and was bound in camp.

sentences.zh: 使先降者諭之使降，徽言大罵，與統制孫昂皆不屈，乃並殺之。

translations.literal: Those who had submitted first were sent to instruct him to submit; Huiyan cursed loudly, and he and the controller Sun Ang both would not yield, and they were both killed.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier submitters were sent to urge him to yield; Huiyan cursed them, and he and the controller Sun Ang would not bend, so both were executed.

sentences.zh: 遂降定安堡、渭平寨及鄜、坊二州。

translations.literal: Thereupon Ding'an Fortress, Weiping Stockade, and the two prefectures of Fu and Fang submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Ding'an Fort, Weiping Stockade, and Fu and Fang prefectures then surrendered.

sentences.zh: 於是，婁室、婆盧火守延安，折可求屯綏德，蒲察還守蒲州。

translations.literal: Thereupon Lou Shi and Poluhuo guarded Yan'an, Zhe Keqiu encamped at Suide, and Pucha returned to guard Pu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi and Poluhuo garrisoned Yan'an, Zhe Keqiu held Suide, and Pucha returned to Pu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 延安、鄜、坊州皆殘破，人民存者無幾，婁室置官府輯安之。

translations.literal: Yan'an and the prefectures of Fu and Fang were all ravaged; few of the people survived; Lou Shi set up offices to put things in order and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Yan'an, Fu, and Fang lay in ruins with few people left; Lou Shi set up offices to restore order and calm the region.

sentences.zh: 別將斡論降建昌軍。

translations.literal: The separate commander Wolun received the submission of Jianchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: A detached column under Wolun secured Jianchang Army.

sentences.zh: 京兆府叛，婁室複討平之。

translations.literal: Jingzhao Prefecture rebelled; Lou Shi again suppressed and pacified it.
translations.idiomatic: Chang'an rebelled, and Lou Shi put the revolt down again.

sentences.zh: 遂與阿盧補、謀里也至三原，訛哥金、阿骨欲擊淳化兵，敗之。

translations.literal: He then with Alubu and Mouyeli reached Sanyuan; Egejin and Aguyu attacked Chunhua troops and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Alubu and Mouyeli at Sanyuan; Egejin and Aguyu struck Chunhua troops and routed them.

sentences.zh: 婁室攻乾州，已築甬道，列鹈駁具，而州降。

translations.literal: Lou Shi attacked Qian Prefecture; he had already built a siege gallery and arrayed catapults and rams, and then the prefecture submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi besieged Qianzhou, had already built a gallery and lined up siege engines, and the city surrendered.

sentences.zh: 遂進兵克邠州，軍於京兆。

translations.literal: He then advanced and took Bin Prefecture and encamped at Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced, took Binzhou, and encamped at Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 陝西城邑已降定者，輒複叛，於是睿宗以右副元帥，總陝西征伐。

translations.literal: The cities and towns of Shaanxi that had already submitted would rebel again; thereupon the Ruizong, as deputy commander on the right, took overall command of the Shaanxi campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Towns in Shaanxi that had surrendered rose again, and the Ruizong took overall command of the western campaign as deputy commander on the right.

sentences.zh: 時婁室已有疾，睿宗與張浚戰于富平，宗弼左翼軍已卻，婁室以右翼力戰，軍勢複振，張浚軍遂敗。

translations.literal: At that time Lou Shi was already ill; the Ruizong fought Zhang Jun at Fuping; Zongbi's left-wing army had already retreated, but Lou Shi on the right wing fought fiercely and the army's momentum revived, and Zhang Jun's army was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi was already ill when the Ruizong met Zhang Jun at Fuping; Zongbi's left wing had given way, but Lou Shi on the right fought on through his sickness, the line rallied, and Zhang Jun was beaten.

sentences.zh: 睿宗曰：「力疾鏖戰，以徇王事，遂破巨敵，雖古名將何以加也。」

translations.literal: The Ruizong said, "Fighting through illness to exhaust himself for the king's affairs and thereby breaking a great enemy—what ancient famous general could surpass this?"
translations.idiomatic: The Ruizong said, "To fight through sickness for the throne and break so great an enemy—what famous general of old could do more?"

sentences.zh: 以所用犀玉金銀器，及甲胄，並馬七匹與之。

translations.literal: He gave him the rhinoceros horn, jade, gold, and silver vessels he used, together with armor and seven horses.
translations.idiomatic: He gave him the rhinoceros-horn, jade, gold, and silver vessels he had used, his armor, and seven horses.

sentences.zh: 天會八年，薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tianhui he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tianhui he died.

sentences.zh: 十三年，贈泰甯軍節度使，兼侍中，加太子太師。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was posthumously made military commissioner of the Taining Army and concurrently Palace Attendant, and promoted to Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was posthumously made military commissioner of Taining Army and Palace Attendant, with the additional title Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 皇統元年，贈開府儀同三司，追封莘王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangtong he was posthumously made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Ceremony of an Imperial Procession and enfeoffed as Prince of Shen retroactively.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huangtong he was posthumously made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Imperial Procession and enfeoffed as Prince of Shen.

sentences.zh: 以正隆例改贈金源郡王，配享太宗廟廷，諡壯義。

translations.literal: By the Zhenglong precedent his posthumous gift was changed to Prince of Jinyuan Commandery; he was given a place in the Taizong temple sacrifices, with the posthumous title Zhuangyi.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhenglong precedent his honors were raised to Prince of Jinyuan and he was given a place in the Taizong temple, with the posthumous title Zhuangyi.

sentences.zh: 子活女、謀衍、石古乃。

translations.literal: His sons were Huonu, Mouyan, and Shigunai.
translations.idiomatic: His sons were Huonu, Mouyan, and Shigunai.

sentences.zh: 子 活女

translations.literal: Son Huonu
translations.idiomatic: Son Huonu

sentences.zh: 活女，年十七從攻甯江州，力戰創甚，扶出陣間。

translations.literal: Huonu, at age seventeen followed in the attack on Ningjiang Prefecture, fought fiercely and was badly wounded, and was helped out from within the battle line.
translations.idiomatic: Huonu was seventeen when he joined the assault on Ningjiang, fought until badly wounded, and was carried from the line.

sentences.zh: 太祖憑高望見，問之，知是婁室子，親撫慰賜藥，歎曰：「此兒他日必為名將。」

translations.literal: The Taizu from a height saw and asked; learning he was Lou Shi's son, he personally comforted him and gave medicine, sighing, "This boy will surely be a famous general another day."
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu looked down from a height, asked who he was, and learning he was Lou Shi's son came down to comfort him and give medicine, saying, "This boy will be a famous general one day."

sentences.zh: 其攻濟州，敗敵八千。

translations.literal: In his attack on Ji Prefecture he defeated eight thousand of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: At the siege of Jizhou he routed eight thousand enemy troops.

sentences.zh: 與敵遇於信州，移刺本陷於陣，活女力戰出之，敵遂北。

translations.literal: Meeting the enemy at Xin Prefecture, Yiciben was trapped in the line; Huonu fought fiercely and brought him out, and the enemy then fled north.
translations.idiomatic: At Xinzhou he met the enemy; Yiciben was trapped in the line, Huonu fought him clear, and the enemy withdrew north.

sentences.zh: 敗耶律佛頂等兵於瀋州。

translations.literal: He defeated the troops of Yelü Foding and others at Shen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated the forces of Yelü Foding and others at Shenzhou.

sentences.zh: 及宗翰以兵襲奚王霞末，活女以兵三百，敗敵二千。

translations.literal: When Zonghan attacked the Xi king Xiamo with troops, Huonu with three hundred troops defeated two thousand of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: When Zonghan struck the Xi king Xiamo, Huonu with three hundred men routed two thousand enemy troops.

sentences.zh: 從攻乙室部，敗之，破其二營。

translations.literal: He followed in the attack on the Yishi tribe, defeated them, and broke two of their camps.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the assault on the Yishi tribe, defeated them, and destroyed two camps.

sentences.zh: 迭刺部族叛，率二謀克突入，大破之。

translations.literal: The Diela tribal group rebelled; he led two meng'an in a sudden thrust and defeated them badly.
translations.idiomatic: When the Diela tribes rebelled, he led two meng'an in a sudden charge and broke them completely.

sentences.zh: 活女常從婁室圍太原，宋將种師中以兵十萬來援，活女擊敗之。

translations.literal: Huonu often followed Lou Shi in besieging Taiyuan; the Song general Zhong Shizhong came to relieve it with one hundred thousand troops, and Huonu defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Huonu often served with Lou Shi at the siege of Taiyuan; when the Song general Zhong Shizhong marched to relieve the city with one hundred thousand men, Huonu routed him.

sentences.zh: 大軍至河，無船，不得渡。

translations.literal: The great army reached the river; there were no boats and they could not cross.
translations.idiomatic: The main army reached the river but had no boats and could not cross.

sentences.zh: 婁室遣活女循水上下，活女率軍三百，自孟津而下，度其可渡，遂引軍以濟，大軍於是皆繼之。

translations.literal: Lou Shi sent Huonu up and down along the water; Huonu led three hundred troops downstream from Mengjin, judged where crossing was possible, and then led the army across, and the great army thereafter all followed.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shi sent Huonu to scout along the river; Huonu took three hundred men downstream from Mengjin, found a ford, crossed, and the whole army followed.

sentences.zh: 宋將郭京出兵數萬，趨婁室營，活女從旁奮擊，敵亂，遂破之。

translations.literal: The Song general Guo Jing led out tens of thousands of troops toward Lou Shi's camp; Huonu struck fiercely from the flank, the enemy fell into disorder, and he broke them.
translations.idiomatic: The Song general Guo Jing led tens of thousands against Lou Shi's camp; Huonu hit them from the flank, threw them into disorder, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 師還，破敵于平陸渡，得其船以濟。

translations.literal: On the army's return he defeated the enemy at Pinglu Ford and took their boats to cross.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march he beat the enemy at Pinglu Ford and seized their boats to cross.

sentences.zh: 又以兵破敵于張店原。

translations.literal: Again with troops he defeated the enemy at Zhangdian Plain.
translations.idiomatic: He again defeated enemy forces at Zhangdian Plain.

sentences.zh: 時屯留、太平、翼城皆有重敵，並破之。

translations.literal: At that time Tunliu, Taiping, and Yicheng all had strong enemies, and he defeated them all.
translations.idiomatic: At Tunliu, Taiping, and Yicheng he met strong resistance and defeated every force.

sentences.zh: 又分兵取陝西，蒲州降，留活女鎮之。

translations.literal: Again he divided troops to take Shaanxi; Pu Prefecture submitted and he left Huonu to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: He detached troops into Shaanxi; Pu Prefecture surrendered and he left Huonu to hold it.

sentences.zh: 攻鳳翔，活女先登。

translations.literal: In the attack on Fengxiang, Huonu was first to mount the wall.
translations.idiomatic: At the assault on Fengxiang, Huonu was first over the wall.

sentences.zh: 睿宗定陝西，活女為都統，進攻涇州，敗其兵。

translations.literal: When the Ruizong secured Shaanxi, Huonu was made commander-in-chief, advanced against Jing Prefecture, and defeated its troops.
translations.idiomatic: After the Ruizong pacified Shaanxi, Huonu became commander-in-chief, marched on Jingzhou, and routed its army.

sentences.zh: 王開山以兵拒歸路，邀戰，再擊，再敗之，遂降京兆、鳳翔諸縣。

translations.literal: Wang Kaishan with troops blocked the return route and offered battle; twice he struck and twice defeated him, and thereby received the submission of the counties of Jingzhao and Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Kaishan blocked the line of retreat and gave battle; Huonu attacked twice and beat him both times, and Chang'an and Fengxiang counties submitted.

sentences.zh: 婁室薨，襲合紮猛安，代為黃龍府路萬戶。

translations.literal: When Lou Shi died, he inherited the Hezha meng'an and succeeded him as commander of ten thousand households of the Huanglong Route.
translations.idiomatic: After Lou Shi died, he inherited the Hezha meng'an and succeeded him as commander of ten thousand households on the Huanglong Route.

sentences.zh: 天眷二年，為元帥右都監，遷左監軍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianjuan he was made right overseer of the commander-in-chief and transferred to left military overseer.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tianjuan he became right overseer under the commander-in-chief and was later made left military overseer.

sentences.zh: 元帥府罷，改安化軍節度使。

translations.literal: When the commander-in-chief's office was abolished, he was changed to military commissioner of the Anhua Army.
translations.idiomatic: When the marshal's office was abolished, he was made military commissioner of the Anhua Army.

sentences.zh: 曆京兆尹，封廣平郡王，以正隆例，改封代國公，進封隋國公，諡貞濟。

translations.literal: He served as prefect of Jingzhao, was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangping Commandery, and by the Zhenglong precedent was changed to Duke of Dai, advanced to Duke of Sui, with the posthumous title Zhenji.
translations.idiomatic: He served as prefect of Chang'an, was made Prince of Guangping, then by the Zhenglong precedent Duke of Dai, advanced to Duke of Sui, with the posthumous title Zhenji.

sentences.zh: 卒年六十一。

translations.literal: He died at age sixty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died at sixty-one.

sentences.zh: 子 謀衍

translations.literal: Son Mouyan
translations.idiomatic: Son Mouyan

sentences.zh: 謀衍，勇力過人，善用長矛突戰。

translations.literal: Mouyan's courage and strength surpassed others; he was skilled in using the long spear for charging battle.
translations.idiomatic: Mouyan was exceptionally strong and brave and excelled at spear charges in battle.

sentences.zh: 天眷間，充牌印祗候，授顯武將軍，擢符寶郎。

translations.literal: During Tianjuan he served as attendant for seals and documents, was appointed General of Manifest Martiality, and was promoted to Keeper of Seals and Treasures.
translations.idiomatic: During Tianjuan he served as seal attendant, was made General of Manifest Martiality, and rose to Keeper of Seals and Treasures.

sentences.zh: 皇統四年，其兄活女襲濟州路萬戶，以親管奧吉猛安讓謀衍，朝廷從之，權濟州路萬戶。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Huangtong his elder brother Huonu inherited the post of commander of ten thousand households of the Jizhou Route and yielded to Mouyan the auji meng'an he personally administered; the court approved, and Mouyan acted as commander of the Jizhou Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Huangtong his brother Huonu took the Jizhou Route command and gave Mouyan the auji meng'an he had personally held; the court agreed, and Mouyan acted as Jizhou commander.

sentences.zh: 八年，為元右都監。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was made right overseer under the commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he became right overseer under the commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 天德三年，為順天軍節度使，曆河間、臨潢尹，數月改婆速路兵馬都總管。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiande he was military commissioner of the Shuntian Army, served as prefect of Hejian and Linhuang, and after several months was changed to overall commander of troops and horses of the Basu Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tiande he became military commissioner of Shuntian Army, served as prefect of Hejian and Linhuang, and within months was made overall commander of the Basu Route.

sentences.zh: 撒八反，謀衍往討之，是時世宗為東京留守，自將討括里還，遇謀衍于常安縣，盡以甲士付之。

translations.literal: When Saba rebelled, Mouyan went to suppress him; at that time the Shizong was military governor of the Eastern Capital and, having personally led troops against Kuoli and returned, met Mouyan at Chang'an County and entrusted all his armored troops to him.
translations.idiomatic: When Saba rebelled, Mouyan marched to suppress him; the Shizong was then military governor of the Eastern Capital and, returning from a campaign against Kuoli, met Mouyan at Chang'an County and placed all his armored troops under his command.

sentences.zh: 世宗還東京，完顏福壽、高忠建率所部南征軍，亡歸東京。

translations.literal: The Shizong returned to the Eastern Capital; Wanyan Fushou and Gao Zhongjian led the southern campaign forces under their command and fled back to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Shizong returned to the Eastern Capital, and Wanyan Fushou and Gao Zhongjian brought their southern expedition forces back with them.

sentences.zh: 謀衍亦率其軍來附，即以臣禮上謁，遂殺高存福、李彥隆等。

translations.literal: Mouyan also led his army to attach himself, at once paid homage in the manner of a subject, and then killed Gao Cunfu, Li Yanlong, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Mouyan brought his army over as well, paid homage as a subject, and then executed Gao Cunfu, Li Yanlong, and others.

sentences.zh: 謀衍、福壽、忠建及諸將吏民勸進，世宗即位，拜右副元帥。

translations.literal: Mouyan, Fushou, Zhongjian, and the various generals, officials, and people urged him to take the throne; the Shizong ascended and appointed Mouyan deputy commander-in-chief on the right.
translations.idiomatic: Mouyan, Fushou, Zhongjian, and the generals and people urged him to take the throne; when the Shizong ascended he made Mouyan deputy commander-in-chief on the right.

sentences.zh: 都統白彥敬，副統紇石烈志寧在北京，拒不受命，謀衍伐之，遇其眾於建州之境，皆不肯戰，彥敬、志寧遂降。

translations.literal: The commander-in-chief Bai Yanjing and deputy commander-in-chief Heshenlie Zhining were at Beijing and refused to accept orders; Mouyan attacked them, met their forces on the border of Jian Prefecture, and they all refused to fight; Yanjing and Zhining then submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Bai Yanjing and deputy Heshenlie Zhining held Beijing and refused obedience; Mouyan marched against them, met their army on the Jianzhou border, and they would not fight; Yanjing and Zhining surrendered.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，謀衍率諸軍討窩斡，會兵於濟州，合甲士萬三千人，過泰州，至術虎崖，乃舍輜重，持數日糧，輕騎追之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year Mouyan led the various armies to suppress Wowo, assembled troops at Jizhou, totaling thirteen thousand armored soldiers, passed Taizhou, reached Shuhu Cliff, then abandoned baggage, carried several days' provisions, and pursued with light cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year Mouyan led the armies against Wowo, mustered thirteen thousand armored men at Jizhou, passed Taizhou to Shuhu Cliff, left the baggage train behind with only a few days' rations, and pursued with light cavalry.

sentences.zh: 是時窩斡新敗於泰州，將走濟州。

translations.literal: At that time Wowo had just been defeated at Taizhou and was about to flee toward Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wowo had just been beaten at Taizhou and was heading for Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 謀衍兵至長濼南，獲其諜者，知敵將由別路邀糧運，遂分軍往迎之。

translations.literal: Mouyan's army reached the south of Chang Marsh, captured a spy, learned the enemy would intercept the supply train by another route, and therefore divided troops to meet them.
translations.idiomatic: Mouyan reached the south of Chang Marsh, took a spy, learned the enemy would ambush the supply column by another road, and split his force to intercept them.

sentences.zh: 敵吏者來降，謀衍用其計，因夜亟往邀敵輜重，忽大風，不能燧火，路暗莫相辨，比曉才行三十餘里。

translations.literal: An enemy clerk came to submit; Mouyan used his plan and hurried by night to intercept enemy baggage; suddenly a great wind arose and they could not light signal fires; the road was dark and they could not distinguish one another; by dawn they had gone only a little more than thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: An enemy clerk defected and Mouyan followed his advice, marching by night to cut off the baggage train; a sudden gale blew out every torch, men could not see one another in the dark, and by dawn they had covered only thirty-odd li.

sentences.zh: 將至敵營，將士少憩，謀衍率善射者數十騎，往覘之。

translations.literal: As they were about to reach the enemy camp the officers and soldiers rested briefly; Mouyan led several dozen skilled archers on horseback to reconnoiter.
translations.idiomatic: Near the enemy camp the troops paused to rest; Mouyan took several dozen expert archers forward to scout.

sentences.zh: 而都統志甯、克寧等，已敗敵眾二萬餘於長濼，追殺甚眾，敵遂西遁。

translations.literal: But the commander-in-chief Zhining, Kening, and others had already defeated more than twenty thousand of the enemy at Chang Marsh, pursued and killed many, and the enemy then fled west.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Zhining, Kening, and others had already routed over twenty thousand rebels at Chang Marsh, killed many in pursuit, and the enemy fled west.

sentences.zh: 志甯軍先追及於霿{箣松}河，急擊敗之。

translations.literal: Zhining's army first caught up at the Mingshui River and pressed the attack and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhining's troops first caught them at the Mingshui River and routed them in a sharp fight.

sentences.zh: 而謀衍貪鹵掠，不復追，以故敵得縱去，遂涉懿州界，陷靈山、同昌、惠和等縣，窺取北京，西敗三韓縣。

translations.literal: But Mouyan, greedy for plunder, did not pursue further; because of this the enemy was able to escape, crossed into Yizhou territory, took Lingshan, Tongchang, Huihe, and other counties, eyed Beijing, and defeated Sanhan County in the west.
translations.idiomatic: Mouyan, busy with loot, did not pursue, so the enemy got away, crossed into Yizhou, overran Lingshan, Tongchang, Huihe, and other counties, threatened Beijing, and beat Sanhan County in the west.

sentences.zh: 惟克寧軍追躡，謀衍托馬弱，引還懿州。

translations.literal: Only Kening's army pursued closely; Mouyan pleaded weak horses and led his troops back to Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Only Kening kept up the pursuit; Mouyan claimed his horses were spent and withdrew to Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 上聞之，下詔切責謀衍，以僕散忠義為右副元帥代之，紇石烈志寧為右監軍代完顏福壽。

translations.literal: When the sovereign heard of it he issued an edict sharply rebuking Mouyan, made Pusan Zhongyi deputy commander-in-chief on the right in his place, and Heshenlie Zhining right military overseer in place of Wanyan Fushou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard of it and rebuked Mouyan by edict, replaced him with Pusan Zhongyi as deputy commander on the right, and made Heshenlie Zhining right overseer in place of Wanyan Fushou.

sentences.zh: 而謀衍子斜哥暴橫軍中，詔勒歸本貫。

translations.literal: Mouyan's son Xiege was violent and overbearing in the army; an edict ordered him returned to his native registration.
translations.idiomatic: Mouyan's son Xiege had been brutal in camp; an edict sent him back to his home register.

sentences.zh: 謀衍至京師，以為同判大宗正事，世宗責之曰：「朕以汝為將，汝不追賊，當正汝罪。

translations.literal: Mouyan reached the capital and was made associate judge of the Grand Imperial Clan Court; the Shizong rebuked him, saying, "I made you a general, yet you did not pursue the bandits—you should be punished for your crime.
translations.idiomatic: Mouyan reached the capital and was made associate judge of the Grand Imperial Clan Court; the Shizong rebuked him: "I made you a general and you let the rebels go—you deserve punishment.

sentences.zh: 以汝父婁室有大功，特免汝死。

translations.literal: Because your father Lou Shi had great merit, I specially spare your life.
translations.idiomatic: Because your father Lou Shi served with great merit, I spare your life.

sentences.zh: 汝雖非宗室，而授此職，汝其勉之。」

translations.literal: Although you are not of the imperial clan, yet I give you this office—you must exert yourself."
translations.idiomatic: You are not of the imperial clan, yet I give you this post—do your best."

sentences.zh: 未幾，速頻路軍士朮里古，告斜哥寄書與謀衍謀反，有司並上其書，世宗察其誣，詔鞫告者，朮里古款伏，遂誅之。

translations.literal: Before long a soldier of the Supin Route named Shuligu reported that Xiege had sent a letter to Mouyan plotting rebellion; the authorities together submitted the letter; the Shizong saw it was a false accusation, ordered the accuser interrogated, Shuligu confessed fully, and he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon a Supin Route soldier named Shuligu claimed Xiege had written to Mouyan plotting rebellion; the authorities submitted the letter, the Shizong saw the charge was false, had the accuser examined, Shuligu confessed, and was executed.

sentences.zh: 召謀衍謂之曰：「人有告卿子為反謀者，朕知卿必不為此，今告者果自服罪，宜悉此意。」

translations.literal: He summoned Mouyan and said to him, "Someone reported that your son plotted rebellion; I know you would certainly not do this; now the accuser has indeed confessed his crime—you should fully understand this intent."
translations.idiomatic: He summoned Mouyan and said, "Someone accused your son of rebellion; I knew you would never do such a thing, and the accuser has confessed. Put the matter out of your mind."

sentences.zh: 初，窩斡方熾，上使溫蒂罕阿魯帶，守古北口。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Wowo was still powerful, the sovereign sent Wendihan Aludai to guard Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, while Wowo was still strong, the emperor sent Wendihan Aludai to hold Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 及窩斡敗於陷泉，入于奚中，率諸奚攻古北口。

translations.literal: When Wowo was defeated at Xianquan and entered among the Xi, he led the various Xi to attack Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: When Wowo was beaten at Xianquan he fled among the Xi and led them against Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 阿魯帶因其妻生日，輒離軍六十里，賊眾聞之，來襲，殺傷士卒甚眾。

translations.literal: Aludai because of his wife's birthday abruptly left the army sixty li; the bandits heard of it, came to attack, and killed and wounded very many soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Aludai left camp for his wife's birthday and was sixty li away when the rebels heard and struck, killing and wounding many men.

sentences.zh: 阿魯帶坐除名。

translations.literal: Aludai was punished by removal from the register.
translations.idiomatic: Aludai was struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 詔謀衍，蒲察烏里雅、蒲察通以兵三千，會舊屯兵，擊之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Mouyan, Pucha Wuliya, and Pucha Tong with three thousand troops to join the old garrison troops and attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Mouyan, Pucha Wuliya, and Pucha Tong were ordered to take three thousand men, join the existing garrison, and attack.

sentences.zh: 擒賊党猛安合住。

translations.literal: They captured the bandit partisan Meng'an Hezhu.
translations.idiomatic: They captured the rebel partisan Meng'an Hezhu.

sentences.zh: 未幾，窩斡平，乃還。

translations.literal: Before long Wowo was pacified, and they then returned.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Wowo was suppressed and they returned.

sentences.zh: 七年，出為北京留守，上禦便殿，賜食，及禦服衣帶佩刀，謂之曰：「以卿故老，欲以均勞逸，故授此職，卿其勉之。」

translations.literal: In the seventh year he went out as military governor of Beijing; the sovereign attended him in the side hall, bestowed food, and imperial garments, belt, and wearing sword, saying to him, "Because you are old in service, I wish to balance labor and rest, and therefore give you this post—you must exert yourself."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was made military governor of Beijing; the emperor received him in the side hall, gave a meal, imperial dress, belt, and sword, and said, "You have served long; I mean to ease your burdens with this post—do your best."

sentences.zh: 改東京留守，封榮國公。

translations.literal: He was changed to military governor of the Eastern Capital and enfeoffed as Duke of Rong.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to military governor of the Eastern Capital and enfeoffed as Duke of Rong.

sentences.zh: 大定十一年，薨，年六十四。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Dading he died, at age sixty-four.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Dading he died at sixty-four.

sentences.zh: 謀衍性忠厚，善擊球射獵，時論以為雖智略不及其父，而勇敢肖之雲。

translations.literal: Mouyan's nature was loyal and generous; he was skilled at polo and hunting; contemporary opinion held that although his strategy did not match his father's, in courage he resembled him, it was said.
translations.idiomatic: Mouyan was loyal and open-hearted, skilled at polo and the hunt; opinion held that though he lacked his father's strategic gifts, in courage he was his father's match.

sentences.zh: 子 仲

translations.literal: Son Zhong
translations.idiomatic: Son Zhong

sentences.zh: 正隆六年，伐宋，為神勇軍副都總管。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhenglong, in the campaign against Song, he was deputy overall commander of the Shenyong Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhenglong, during the campaign against Song, he served as deputy overall commander of the Shenyong Army.

sentences.zh: 與大軍北還，除同知大興尹，將兵二千，益遵化屯軍。

translations.literal: When the great army returned north he was made associate prefect of Daxing, led two thousand troops, and reinforced the garrison at Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army marched north he became associate prefect of Daxing, took two thousand troops, and reinforced the Zunhua garrison.

sentences.zh: 備契丹。

translations.literal: To guard against the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: To guard against the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 遷西南路招討使，兼天德軍節度使，政尚忠信，決獄公平，蕃部不敢寇邊。

translations.literal: He was transferred to pacification commissioner of the Southwest Route and concurrently military commissioner of the Tiande Army; his government valued loyalty and trust, his judgments in cases were fair, and the frontier tribes did not dare raid the border.
translations.idiomatic: He became pacification commissioner of the Southwest Route and military commissioner of Tiande Army; his rule was marked by loyalty and trust, fair judgments, and frontier tribes did not dare raid.

sentences.zh: 召為左副都點檢，宿衛嚴謹，每事有規矩，後來者守其法，莫能易也。

translations.literal: He was summoned as left associate chief inspector; his palace guard duty was strict and careful; in every matter there were rules, and those who came after kept his methods and none could change them.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as left associate chief inspector; his palace guard was strict and methodical, and successors kept his rules unchanged.

sentences.zh: 世宗常謂侍臣曰：「石古乃入直，朕寢益安。」

translations.literal: The Shizong often told his attending ministers, "When Shigunai is on duty, I sleep more peacefully."
translations.idiomatic: The Shizong often told his ministers, "When Shigunai is on duty I sleep more soundly."

sentences.zh: 五年，宋人請和，為侄國，不稱臣，仲為報問使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Song requested peace as a nephew state without styling themselves subjects; Zhong was the returning envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Song sought peace as a nephew state without calling themselves subjects, and Zhong was sent as returning envoy.

sentences.zh: 仲請與宋主相見禮儀，世宗曰：「宋主親起立接書，則授之。」

translations.literal: Zhong asked about the ceremony for meeting the Song sovereign; the Shizong said, "If the Song sovereign personally rises to receive the document standing, then hand it over."
translations.idiomatic: Zhong asked about protocol for meeting the Song emperor; the Shizong said, "If the Song emperor rises in person to receive the document, then hand it over."

sentences.zh: 及至宋，一一如禮。

translations.literal: When he reached Song, everything was exactly according to protocol.
translations.idiomatic: In Song everything was carried out exactly as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 正隆用兵，宋人執商州刺史完顏守能以歸，至是，仲取守能與俱還，上嘉之。

translations.literal: During the Zhenglong military campaign the Song seized and took back the Shangzhou prefect Wanyan Shouneng; at this time Zhong brought Shouneng back with him, and the sovereign praised him.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenglong war the Song had taken Shangzhou prefect Wanyan Shouneng; Zhong now brought him back, and the emperor commended him.

sentences.zh: 轉都點檢，兼侍衛親軍都指揮使，遷河南路統軍使，上曰：「卿在禁近，小心畏慎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to chief inspector, concurrently commander-in-chief of the Palace Guard, and moved to commander of the Henan Route; the sovereign said, "You are in close attendance at the forbidden precinct—be careful and cautious.
translations.idiomatic: He became chief inspector and commander of the Palace Guard, then commander of the Henan Route; the emperor said, "You have served close at hand with care and caution.

sentences.zh: 河南控制江、淮，為國重地，卿益勉之。」

translations.literal: Henan controls the Yangzi and Huai and is a vital region of the state—you must exert yourself still more."
translations.idiomatic: Henan commands the Yangzi and Huai and is vital to the realm—apply yourself all the more."

sentences.zh: 賜廄馬、金帶、玉吐鶻。

translations.literal: He was given stable horses, a gold belt, and a jade tuhu.
translations.idiomatic: He received stable horses, a gold belt, and a jade tuhu.

sentences.zh: 後有罪，解職。

translations.literal: Later he had an offense and was removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: He later committed an offense and was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 久之，起為西北路招討使，改北京留守，卒。

translations.literal: After a long time he was raised up as pacification commissioner of the Northwest Route, changed to military governor of Beijing, and died.
translations.idiomatic: After a long interval he was restored as pacification commissioner of the Northwest Route, then made military governor of Beijing, and died there.

sentences.zh: 族子 海里

translations.literal: Clan son Haili
translations.idiomatic: Clan son Haili

sentences.zh: 海里，婁室族子。

translations.literal: Haili was a clan son of Lou Shi.
translations.idiomatic: Haili was a clansman of Lou Shi.

sentences.zh: 體貌豐偉，善用槊。

translations.literal: His physique was large and imposing; he was skilled with the spear.
translations.idiomatic: He was large and imposing and skilled with the spear.

sentences.zh: 婁室為黃龍府萬戶，海里從徙于孰吉訛母。

translations.literal: When Lou Shi was commander of ten thousand households of Huanglong Prefecture, Haili followed in moving to Shujie'emu.
translations.idiomatic: When Lou Shi became commander of ten thousand households at Huanglong, Haili moved with him to Shujie'emu.

sentences.zh: 從婁室追及遼主于朔州阿敦山，遼主從數十騎逸去，婁室遣海里及朮得，往見遼主，諭之使降。

translations.literal: Following Lou Shi he caught up with the Liao sovereign at Adun Mountain in Shuozhou; the Liao sovereign fled with several dozen horsemen; Lou Shi sent Haili and Shude to go see the Liao sovereign and instruct him to submit.
translations.idiomatic: With Lou Shi he overtook the Liao emperor at Adun Mountain in Shuozhou; the emperor fled with a few dozen horsemen, and Lou Shi sent Haili and Shude to parley for his surrender.

sentences.zh: 遼主已窮蹙，待于阿敦山之東，婁室因獲之，賞海里金五十兩、銀五百兩、幣帛二百匹、綿三百兩。

translations.literal: The Liao sovereign was already in desperate straits and waited east of Adun Mountain; Lou Shi thereby captured him and rewarded Haili with fifty liang of gold, five hundred liang of silver, two hundred bolts of silks, and three hundred liang of cotton.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao emperor, cornered, waited east of Adun Mountain; Lou Shi took him and rewarded Haili with fifty liang of gold, five hundred of silver, two hundred bolts of silk, and three hundred liang of cotton.

sentences.zh: 睿宗經略陝西，海里戰卻吳玠軍於涇、邠之南，尋遣修棧道，宋人恐棧道成，以兵來拒，破其兵，賞銀百五十兩、奴婢十人。

translations.literal: When the Ruizong directed operations in Shaanxi, Haili fought and repelled Wu Jie's army south of Jing and Bin, then was sent to build a plank road; the Song feared the plank road would be completed and came with troops to resist; he defeated their troops and was rewarded with one hundred fifty liang of silver and ten slaves.
translations.idiomatic: During the Ruizong's Shaanxi campaign Haili drove back Wu Jie's army south of Jing and Bin, then was sent to build a plank road; the Song tried to stop it and he routed them, earning one hundred fifty liang of silver and ten slaves.

sentences.zh: 天眷元年，擢宿直將軍。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianjuan he was promoted to palace duty general.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianjuan he was promoted to palace duty general.

sentences.zh: 與定宗磐、宗雋之亂，再遷廣威將軍，除都水使者。

translations.literal: In settling the disorders of Zongpan and Zongjun he was twice transferred, to General of Broad Might, and made commissioner of waterways.
translations.idiomatic: In suppressing the disorders of Zongpan and Zongjun he was twice promoted, to General of Broad Might and commissioner of waterways.

sentences.zh: 改西北路招討都監，曆複州、灤州刺史。

translations.literal: He was changed to overseer of pacification of the Northwest Route and served as prefect of Fu and Luan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He became overseer of Northwest Route pacification and served as prefect of Fu and Luan.

sentences.zh: 耶盧椀群牧使，迭刺部族節度使，同知大興尹、兼中都路兵馬都總管，改武甯軍節度使，廣甯尹。

translations.literal: Commissioner of herds for Yeluwan, military commissioner of the Diela tribal group, associate prefect of Daxing and concurrently overall commander of troops and horses of the Central Capital Route, changed to military commissioner of the Wuning Army and prefect of Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: He was herds commissioner for Yeluwan, military commissioner of the Diela tribes, associate prefect of Daxing and overall commander of Central Capital forces, then military commissioner of Wuning Army and prefect of Guangning.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十二。

translations.literal: He died at age sixty-two.
translations.idiomatic: He died at sixty-two.

sentences.zh: 銀朮可

translations.literal: Yinzhuke
translations.idiomatic: Yinzhuke

sentences.zh: 銀朮可，宗室子。

translations.literal: Yinzhuke was a son of the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Yinzhuke was of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 太祖嗣位，使蒲家奴如遼取阿疏，事久不決，乃使習古乃、銀朮可繼往。

translations.literal: When the Taizu succeeded to the throne he sent Pujianu to the Liao to fetch Ashu; the matter long went unresolved, and he then sent Xigunai and Yinzhuke to follow.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizu succeeded he sent Pujianu to the Liao to fetch Ashu; after long delay he sent Xigunai and Yinzhuke after him.

sentences.zh: 當是時，遼主荒於政，上下解體。

translations.literal: At that time the Liao sovereign was negligent in government and above and below were falling apart.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao emperor neglected government and the realm was coming apart.

sentences.zh: 銀朮可等還，具以遼政事人情告太祖，且言遼國可伐之狀。

translations.literal: When Yinzhuke and the others returned they fully reported to the Taizu the Liao government's affairs and popular sentiment, and moreover spoke of the condition in which the Liao state could be attacked.
translations.idiomatic: Yinzhuke and the others returned and told the Taizu in detail how Liao government and morale stood, and that the state could be attacked.

sentences.zh: 太祖決意伐遼，蓋自銀朮可等發之。

translations.literal: The Taizu resolved to attack the Liao—this was essentially initiated by Yinzhuke and the others.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu's decision to attack Liao began with Yinzhuke and the others.

sentences.zh: 太祖與耶律訛里朵戰于達魯古城，遼兵二十余萬，銀朮可、婁室率眾沖其中堅，凡九陷陣，輒戰而出，大敗遼軍。

translations.literal: The Taizu fought Yelü Eliduo at Dalucheng; Liao troops were more than two hundred thousand; Yinzhuke and Lou Shi led the masses in charging the center; nine times they entered the line and each time fought out, and badly defeated the Liao army.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu fought Yelü Eliduo at Dalucheng with over two hundred thousand Liao troops; Yinzhuke and Lou Shi charged the center nine times, fought clear each time, and routed the Liao army.

sentences.zh: 銀朮可為謀克，遂與婁室戍邊，複與婁室、渾黜、婆盧火、石古乃等攻黃龍府，敗遼兵萬余于白馬濼。

translations.literal: Yinzhuke was made a meng'an, then garrisoned the border with Lou Shi, and again with Lou Shi, Hunchu, Poluhuo, Shigunai, and others attacked Huanglong Prefecture and defeated more than ten thousand Liao troops at Baima Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: Yinzhuke became a meng'an, garrisoned the frontier with Lou Shi, and with Lou Shi, Hunchu, Poluhuo, and Shigunai attacked Huanglong and routed over ten thousand Liao troops at Baima Marsh.

sentences.zh: 太祖拒遼兵，銀朮可守達魯古城。

translations.literal: The Taizu held off Liao troops while Yinzhuke guarded Dalucheng.
translations.idiomatic: While the Taizu held off the Liao, Yinzhuke guarded Dalucheng.

sentences.zh: 收國二年，分鴨撻、阿懶所遷謀克二千戶，以銀朮可為謀克，屯甯江州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shouguo two thousand households of meng'an relocated by Yata and Alan were divided off, and Yinzhuke was made meng'an and encamped at Ningjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shouguo two thousand meng'an households relocated by Yata and Alan were assigned to Yinzhuke, who encamped at Ningjiang.

sentences.zh: 遼大冊使習泥烈遣回，約以七月半至，而盡九月習泥烈未來，上使諸軍過江屯駐。

translations.literal: The Liao grand envoy Xini Lie was sent back, agreeing to arrive by the middle of the seventh month, yet by the end of the ninth month Xini Lie had not come, and the sovereign had the various armies cross the river and encamp.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao grand envoy Xini Lie was sent back promising to arrive by mid-seventh month, but by the end of the ninth month had not come, and the sovereign ordered the armies across the river to camp.

sentences.zh: 遼曳刺、麻答十三人，兵士八人縱火於渾河，以絕芻牧。

translations.literal: Thirteen Liao yeli and Mada and eight soldiers set fire on the Hun River to cut off fodder and pasture.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen Liao scouts and Mada with eight soldiers set fires along the Hun River to destroy fodder and pasture.

sentences.zh: 銀朮可獲之，乃知遼邊吏乙薛使之，太祖命釋之。

translations.literal: Yinzhuke captured them and then knew the Liao border official Yixue had sent them; the Taizu ordered them released.
translations.idiomatic: Yinzhuke captured them, learned the Liao border official Yixue had sent them, and the Taizu ordered them released.

sentences.zh: 從都統杲克中京，銀朮可與習古乃、蒲察、胡巴魯率兵三千，擊奚王霞末於京西七十里，霞未棄兵遁。

translations.literal: Following the commander-in-chief Gao in taking the Central Capital, Yinzhuke with Xigunai, Pucha, and Hubalu led three thousand troops and attacked the Xi king Xiamo seventy li west of the capital; Xiamo abandoned his troops and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Following commander Gao in taking the Central Capital, Yinzhuke with Xigunai, Pucha, and Hubalu led three thousand men, struck the Xi king Xiamo seventy li west of the capital, and Xiamo fled abandoning his army.

sentences.zh: 遼主西奔天德，銀朮可以兵絕其後，遼主遂見獲。

translations.literal: The Liao sovereign fled west to Tiande; Yinzhuke with troops cut off his rear, and the Liao sovereign was thereby captured.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao emperor fled west to Tiande; Yinzhuke blocked his retreat and the emperor was taken.

sentences.zh: 後從宗翰伐宋，圍太原，宗翰進兵至澤州，及宗翰還西京，太原未下，皆命銀朮可留兵圍之。

translations.literal: Afterward he followed Zonghan in attacking Song and besieging Taiyuan; Zonghan advanced his army to Ze Prefecture, and when Zonghan returned to the Western Capital while Taiyuan had not yet fallen, he each time ordered Yinzhuke to leave troops to besiege it.
translations.idiomatic: He later followed Zonghan against the Song and helped besiege Taiyuan. When Zonghan marched on to Ze Prefecture and then returned to the Western Capital while Taiyuan still held out, Yinzhuke was repeatedly left behind to keep the siege.

sentences.zh: 招討都監馬五破宋兵于文水。

translations.literal: Pacification commissioner-in-chief Ma Wu defeated Song troops at Wenshui.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner Ma Wu routed Song forces at Wenshui.

sentences.zh: 節度使耿守忠等敗宋黃迪兵于西都穀，所殺不可勝計。

translations.literal: Military commissioner Geng Shouzhong and others defeated the Song army of Huang Di at Xidu Valley; those killed were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Shouzhong and other Jin commanders crushed Huang Di's Song force in Xidu Valley, killing men beyond count.

sentences.zh: 宋樊夔、施詵、高豐等軍來救太原，分據近部，銀朮可與習失、杯魯、完速大破之。

translations.literal: Song armies of Fan Kui, Shi Shen, Gao Feng, and others came to relieve Taiyuan and held nearby districts separately; Yinzhuke with Xishi, Beilu, and Wansu utterly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Kui, Shi Shen, Gao Feng, and other Song relief columns marched on Taiyuan and seized neighboring districts; Yinzhuke, Xishi, Beilu, and Wansu smashed them.

sentences.zh: 索里乙室，破宋兵於太谷。

translations.literal: Suoliyishi defeated Song troops at Taigu.
translations.idiomatic: Suoliyishi routed the Song at Taigu.

sentences.zh: 宋兵據太谷、祁縣，阿鶻懶、拔離速複取之。

translations.literal: Song troops held Taigu and Qi County; Ahelan and Balisu recaptured them.
translations.idiomatic: The Song occupied Taigu and Qi County; Ahelan and Balisu took both back.

sentences.zh: 种師中出井陘，據榆次，救太原，銀朮可使斡論擊之，破其軍。

translations.literal: Zhong Shizhong came out through Jingxing, took Yuci, and marched to relieve Taiyuan; Yinzhuke sent Wolun to attack him and broke his army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Shizhong came through Jingxing, seized Yuci, and advanced to relieve Taiyuan; Yinzhuke sent Wolun against him and shattered his army.

sentences.zh: 活女斬師中于殺熊嶺，進攻宋制置使姚古軍于隆州穀，大敗之。

translations.literal: Huonu beheaded Shizhong at Shaxiong Ridge, advanced and attacked the army of the Song commissioner Yao Gu at Longzhou Valley, and defeated it utterly.
translations.idiomatic: Huonu cut down Shizhong at Shaxiong Ridge, then struck the army of Song commissioner Yao Gu in Longzhou Valley and routed it completely.

sentences.zh: 撒里土敗宋軍于回馬口，郭企忠殲宋軍於五台。

translations.literal: Saliha defeated the Song army at Huimakou; Guo Qizhong annihilated Song troops at Wutai.
translations.idiomatic: Saliha beat the Song at Huimakou; Guo Qizhong wiped out a Song force at Wutai.

sentences.zh: 及宗翰定太原，與宗望會兵於汴，銀朮可等攻汴城，克之。

translations.literal: When Zonghan secured Taiyuan and joined Zongwang's army at Bian, Yinzhuke and others attacked Bian city and took it.
translations.idiomatic: After Zonghan took Taiyuan and joined Zongwang at Bian, Yinzhuke and the others stormed the city and captured it.

sentences.zh: 師還，銀朮可降岢嵐、寧化等軍，攻嵐州拔之，招降火山軍。

translations.literal: On the army's return Yinzhuke received the submission of the Kezhou and Ninghua garrisons, attacked Lan Prefecture and took it, and won over the Huoshan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the march home Yinzhuke reduced the Kezhou and Ninghua garrisons, stormed and took Lanzhou, and received the surrender of the Huoshan Army.

sentences.zh: 與希尹同賜鐵券。

translations.literal: He was granted an iron certificate of immunity together with Xiyin.
translations.idiomatic: He received an iron certificate of immunity along with Xiyin.

sentences.zh: 宗翰趨洛陽，賽里取汝州，銀朮可取鄧州，殺其將李操等。

translations.literal: Zonghan pressed toward Luoyang; Saili took Ru Prefecture; Yinzhuke took Deng Prefecture and killed its generals Li Cao and others.
translations.idiomatic: Zonghan pushed toward Luoyang; Saili captured Ru Prefecture; Yinzhuke took Dengzhou and killed Li Cao and other Song officers.

sentences.zh: 薩謀魯入襄陽，拔離速入均州，馬五取房州，擒轉運使劉吉、鄧州通判王彬。

translations.literal: Shamolu entered Xiangyang; Balisu entered Jun Prefecture; Ma Wu took Fang Prefecture and captured the transport commissioner Liu Ji and the Dengzhou vice-prefect Wang Bin.
translations.idiomatic: Shamolu entered Xiangyang; Balisu took Junzhou; Ma Wu seized Fangzhou and captured transport commissioner Liu Ji and Dengzhou vice-prefect Wang Bin.

sentences.zh: 拔離速破唐、蔡、陳三州，克潁昌府，沙古質別克舊潁昌。

translations.literal: Balisu broke the three prefectures of Tang, Cai, and Chen, took Yingchang Prefecture, and Shaguzhi separately took old Yingchang.
translations.idiomatic: Balisu overran Tang, Cai, and Chen, captured Yingchang, and Shaguzhi separately recovered old Yingchang.

sentences.zh: 子 彀英

translations.literal: Son: Gouying
translations.idiomatic: His son: Gouying

sentences.zh: 彀英，本名撻懶。

translations.literal: Gouying, original name Talan.
translations.idiomatic: Gouying—born Talan.

sentences.zh: 幼警敏有志膽，初丱角，太祖見而奇之。

translations.literal: As a child he was keen and alert with resolve and daring; when he first wore his hair in tufts the Taizu saw him and marveled.
translations.idiomatic: Even as a boy he was sharp, bold, and full of nerve; when he first wore his hair in childhood tufts the Taizu took notice and was impressed.

sentences.zh: 年十六，父銀朮可授以甲，使從伐遼，常為先鋒，授世襲謀克。

translations.literal: At sixteen his father Yinzhuke gave him armor and sent him to follow the campaign against Liao; he often served as vanguard and was granted a hereditary meng'an.
translations.idiomatic: At sixteen Yinzhuke armed him and sent him on the Liao campaign; he regularly led the van and was granted a hereditary meng'an.

sentences.zh: 宗翰自太原還西京，銀朮可圍守之，彀英在行間，屢有功。

translations.literal: When Zonghan returned from Taiyuan to the Western Capital, Yinzhuke besieged and held it; Gouying was in the ranks and repeatedly won merit.
translations.idiomatic: When Zonghan left Taiyuan for the Western Capital, Yinzhuke kept the siege; Gouying fought in the ranks and distinguished himself again and again.

sentences.zh: 宋兵數萬救太原，至南關，銀朮可與弟拔離速、完顏婁室等擊之，當隘巷間，一卒揮刀向拔離速，彀英以刀斷其腕，一卒複從旁以槍刺之，彀英斷其槍，追殺之。

translations.literal: Tens of thousands of Song troops came to relieve Taiyuan and reached South Pass; Yinzhuke with his younger brother Balisu, Wanyan Lou Shi, and others struck them; in a narrow lane a soldier swung a blade at Balisu; Gouying with his blade severed the man's wrist; another soldier again stabbed from the side with a spear; Gouying cut the spear shaft and pursued and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: When tens of thousands of Song troops came to relieve Taiyuan and reached South Pass, Yinzhuke, his brother Balisu, Wanyan Lou Shi, and others met them in a narrow lane. A soldier slashed at Balisu; Gouying severed his wrist. Another thrust with a spear from the side; Gouying snapped the shaft and ran the man down.

sentences.zh: 拔太原，下河東諸州，攻汴京，皆有功。

translations.literal: In taking Taiyuan, reducing the prefectures of Hedong, and attacking Bianjing he had merit in each.
translations.idiomatic: He earned credit in the fall of Taiyuan, the reduction of Hedong, and the assault on Bianjing.

sentences.zh: 與都統馬五徇地漢上，至上蔡，以先鋒破孔家軍。

translations.literal: With supreme commander Ma Wu he subdued the Han River region, reached Shangcai, and as vanguard broke the Kong family's army.
translations.idiomatic: With supreme commander Ma Wu he swept the Han River country, reached Shangcai, and as vanguard shattered the Kong family army.

sentences.zh: 睿宗攻開州，彀英先登，流矢中其口，睿宗親視之，創未愈，強起之，攻大名府。

translations.literal: When the Ruizong attacked Kai Prefecture Gouying was first to scale the wall; a stray arrow struck his mouth; the Ruizong personally visited him; before the wound healed he was forced to rise and attack Daming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the Ruizong's assault on Kaizhou Gouying was first over the wall, but a stray arrow struck his mouth. The Ruizong visited him in person; before the wound healed he was roused again to attack Daming.

sentences.zh: 第功，宗弼第一，彀英次之。

translations.literal: In ranking merit Zongbi was first and Gouying second.
translations.idiomatic: In the merit roll Zongbi ranked first and Gouying second.

sentences.zh: 攻東平，彀英居最。

translations.literal: In the attack on Dongping Gouying ranked highest.
translations.idiomatic: At Dongping he ranked first.

sentences.zh: 拔離速襲宋康王於揚州，彀英為先鋒。

translations.literal: Balisu raided the Song Prince of Kang at Yangzhou; Gouying served as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Balisu struck the Song Prince of Kang at Yangzhou, Gouying led the van.

sentences.zh: 拔離速追宋孟後於江南，彀英前行趨潭州。

translations.literal: Balisu pursued Song Meng Hou in Jiangnan; Gouying advanced ahead toward Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Balisu pursued Song Meng Hou in the south; Gouying pressed ahead toward Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 宋大兵在常武，彀英以選兵薄其城，敗千餘人。

translations.literal: Great Song forces were at Changwu; Gouying with picked troops pressed the city and defeated more than a thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: A large Song force held Changwu; Gouying closed on the city with picked troops and cut down more than a thousand men.

sentences.zh: 明日，城中出兵來戰，彀英以五百騎敗之，獲馬二百匹，遂攻常武。

translations.literal: Next day troops came out from the city to fight; Gouying with five hundred horsemen defeated them, captured two hundred horses, and then attacked Changwu.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the garrison sallied; Gouying with five hundred horsemen broke them, took two hundred horses, and pressed the attack on Changwu.

sentences.zh: 拔離速以諸軍為大陣，居其後，彀英以五百騎為小陣，當前行，即麾兵馳宋軍，宋軍亂，遂大敗之。

translations.literal: Balisu arrayed the main forces in a great formation and held the rear; Gouying with five hundred horsemen formed a small formation in the front rank; at once he commanded the troops to charge the Song army; the Song army was thrown into disorder and was utterly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Balisu drew up the main body in a great line behind him while Gouying led five hundred horsemen in a small front formation, then charged. The Song line collapsed and was driven off the field.

sentences.zh: 拔離速觀其周旋，歎賞之。

translations.literal: Balisu watched his maneuvering and sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: Balisu watched his handling of the fight and praised him warmly.

sentences.zh: 其後河東郡縣多叛，彀英以先鋒攻絳州，克之。

translations.literal: Afterward many prefectures and counties of Hedong rebelled; Gouying as vanguard attacked Jiang Prefecture and took it.
translations.idiomatic: When many Hedong districts rebelled afterward, Gouying led the van against Jiangzhou and took it.

sentences.zh: 複攻沁州，飛砲擊其石脅，歸營中。

translations.literal: He again attacked Qin Prefecture; a flying-catapult stone struck his hip, and he returned to camp.
translations.idiomatic: He attacked Qinzhou again, but a trebuchet stone struck his hip and he withdrew to camp.

sentences.zh: 諸軍攻沁州，三日不能下，別將骨赧強起彀英指麾士卒，遂克之。

translations.literal: The armies attacked Qin Prefecture but could not take it in three days; the separate commander Gunu forcibly roused Gouying to direct the soldiers, and it was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: The combined force failed to take Qinzhou in three days until the detached commander Gunu had Gouying carried out to command the assault; the city then fell.

sentences.zh: 攝河東路都統，從左監軍移刺餘睹招西北諸部。

translations.literal: Acting as Hedong Route supreme commander, he followed the left military commissioner Yila Yudu in winning over the northwestern tribes.
translations.idiomatic: As acting Hedong Route supreme commander he joined the left military commissioner Yila Yudu in bringing the northwestern tribes to submission.

sentences.zh: 彀英將騎三千五百，平其九部，獲生口三千，馬牛羊十五萬。

translations.literal: Gouying led three thousand five hundred horsemen, pacified their nine tribes, and captured three thousand prisoners, one hundred fifty thousand horses, cattle, and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Gouying led thirty-five hundred horsemen, subdued nine tribes, and took three thousand captives and a hundred fifty thousand head of horses, cattle, and sheep.

sentences.zh: 以先鋒破宋吳山軍，再戰再勝，遂恤宋兵于隘，死者不可勝計，宋兵遁去。

translations.literal: As vanguard he broke the Song Wushan army; fighting twice he won twice; he then pursued Song troops into a defile; the dead were beyond counting and the Song army fled away.
translations.idiomatic: Leading the van he smashed the Song Wushan army, won two fights in succession, then chased the Song into a narrow pass until the dead lay too thick to count and the survivors fled.

sentences.zh: 宗弼再取和尚原，彀英以本部破宋五萬人，遂奪新叉口，宗弼留兵守之。

translations.literal: Zongbi again took Heshangyuan; Gouying with his own command broke fifty thousand Song troops, then seized Xinchakou; Zongbi left troops to hold it.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongbi retook Heshangyuan, Gouying's command routed fifty thousand Song troops, seized Xinchakou, and Zongbi left a garrison there.

sentences.zh: 是夜，大雪，道路皆冰，和尚原宋兵勢重不可徑取，宗弼用彀英微，入自傍近高山叢薄翳薈間，出其不意，遂取和尚原。

translations.literal: That night heavy snow fell and the roads were all ice; at Heshangyuan the Song forces were too strong to be taken directly; Zongbi used Gouying's subtle plan, entering through nearby high mountains among thickets and dense growth, and by surprise took Heshangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: That night snow blocked the roads with ice; the Song hold on Heshangyuan was too strong for a frontal assault, so Zongbi followed Gouying's stratagem and slipped through the high woods above the camp, taking the position by surprise.

sentences.zh: 彀英請速入大散關，自以本部為殿，以備伏兵。

translations.literal: Gouying urged swift entry through Dasanguan and took his own command as rear guard against ambush troops.
translations.idiomatic: Gouying urged a rapid push through Dasanguan while his own command covered the rear against ambush.

sentences.zh: 宗弼至仙人關，彀英先攻之，宗弼止之，彀英不止，宗弼以刀背擊其兜鍪，使之退，彀英曰：「敵氣巳沮，不乘此而取之，後必悔之。」

translations.literal: Zongbi reached Xianrenguan; Gouying attacked first; Zongbi stopped him but Gouying would not stop; Zongbi struck his helmet with the back of the blade and made him withdraw; Gouying said: "The enemy's spirit is already crushed; if we do not seize this to take them we will regret it afterward.
translations.idiomatic: At Xianrenguan Gouying attacked before Zongbi was ready. Zongbi ordered him back; Gouying refused until Zongbi struck his helmet with the flat of a blade. Gouying said, "Their spirit is already broken—if we do not strike now we will regret it later.

sentences.zh: 已而果然。

translations.literal: Before long it proved so indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long events proved him right.

sentences.zh: 宗弼歎曰：「既往不咎。」

translations.literal: Zongbi sighed and said: "What is past is not to be blamed."
